messages:
Aria: Quick sync 1: webinar topic shortlist: "Practical Inference for SaaS" vs "Migration playbook: Open models -> Redwood". Thoughts?
Devon: Both good. Leaning inference for SaaS because it's broader.
Marta: Migration playbook is higher intent. Might convert better but smaller audience.
Aria: We can test both with two landing pages and route traffic to the higher converting one for emails. Devon: love that.
kai-bot: Suggestion: run 2-week prepromo A/B for landing CTA. kai-bot: baseline conversion expected 2-4%.
Aria: Speaker thoughts: want a customer who moved to Redwood + an infra engineer to demo the performance wins.
Devon: Candidates: Mariko (customer success at BetaCorp), Leo (infra), Sam (solutions).
Marta: Availability check: Mariko can do late mornings PT; Leo only afternoons CET; Sam is flexible.
Aria: Draft run-of-show (35 min):
```
00:00-00:03 host intro
00:03-00:15 infra demo (Leo)
00:15-00:22 customer story (Mariko)
00:22-00:30 live Q
00:30-00:35 CTA + trials
```
Devon: We need microbench narratives for the infra demo: 1) latency reduction after batching, 2) cost per 1k tokens with quantization, 3) fallbacks for degraded models.
Marta: Landing page copy variant A: "See how BetaCorp cut inference costs 3x". Variant B: "Migrate to Redwood in under 2 weeks".
Aria: Ops: rehearsal windows next week. Request: 1 dry run that covers NA+EU overlap.
kai-bot: Reminder service will send nudges at 7 days and 1 day. kai-bot: uploading speaker checklist to /marketing/webinars.
Devon: Action items: Aria confirm speakers by EOD, Marta build landing page variants, Kai schedule dry run.
Aria: Good. Will follow up after speaker lock. Thanks.
